comparison.sourceRefBoundary: GetRefSources populates a sole sources entry in 3.5.0 through 3.5.6; earlier pinned patches require more than one entry.
comparison.otherRefChanges: Loop restructuring and rollback revision signatures do not change literal name validation or duplicate detection.
comparison.destinationChanges: Mutual exclusion moves from GetDestinationCluster to GetDestinationServer; database lookup and missing-cluster behavior are outside the local subset.
comparison.renderChanges: Replace uses direct parsing or a cloned base template; function execution and availability remain excluded. Fasttemplate mode is gated by a complete delimiter pair.
comparison.valueFileChanges: Starting at the first pinned 3.4 release (3.4.1), getResolvedValueFiles adds glob expansion and deduplication; this product checks reference identity only and does not expand files.
comparison.policyChanges: ValidatePermissions changes messages and source-hydrator checks; exact URL and destination allow predicates remain identical. Source hydration and controller registration are excluded.
comparison.patchCaller: GenerateApplications and renderTemplatePatch are byte-identical across all 88 pinned versions: any non-nil patch is sent to Replace with the configured GoTemplate mode. Static YAML/object syntax and selected template syntax are checked in both modes; execution and final patch effects remain excluded.
comparison.refActivity: The GetRefSources entry guard controls declaration validation as well as mapping: spec.source refs are not interpreted; pre-3.5 unused sole sources refs are not validated. Diagnostics, navigation and candidates share this activity condition.
